graft.note: SOURCING D-615 LIVE_RECORD, SUPERSEDING THE D-614 REFERENCE_RULING. The MPN was grafted at D-614 from D-238 and SOURCING_LEDGER; the LCSC code was the half DEVICE_SPEC s.16 item 8 still listed as OPEN. JLCPCB record read 2026-09-05: JST SM04B-SRSS-TB(LF)(SN), LCSC C160404, stock 69510, SH series, pitch 1 mm, 4P 1x4P, 1 A, 50 V, -25..+85 C, UL94V-0, surface mount right angle, board footprint 6 mm x 4.32 mm -- every field corroborates D-238 and the land Connector_JST:JST_SH_SM04B-SRSS-TB_1x04-1MP_P1.00mm_Horizontal. The bare order code SM04B-SRSS-TB resolves only to ZERO-STOCK JLCPCB Assembly entries, which is why the plating-suffixed string is the one D-096 requires.
